{'': 'Apple TV+\'s "Slow Horses" and "Dark Matter" are both set to return, alongside "Ted Lasso"'}

{'': 'Now is a great time to subscribe to Apple TV+.'}

{'': '"Ted Lasso" Season 4 has officially returned, with two other hit series hot on its heels.'}

{'': '"Ted Lasso" Season 4 premieres today, with new episodes airing every Wednesday until October 7. The new season not only sees the return of beloved classic characters, but also adds new members to the "Lady Greyhounds."'}

{'': 'In addition to "Lasso," Apple TV+ will premiere new seasons of two other hit series in the coming weeks:'}

{'': '"Slow Horses" Season 6 will premiere on Wednesday, September 16, with new episodes airing weekly until October 21.'}

{'': 'Gary Oldman returns once again, alongside the full team at Slough House. Series synopsis: "In Season 6, the Slow Horses are forced to scatter and flee, with Diana Taverner dragging them all into a high-stakes game of revenge and retribution that could claim their lives at any moment."'}

{'': 'Even sooner—the hit sci-fi series "Dark Matter" will return with a new season.'}

{'': '"Dark Matter" Season 2 will premiere on Friday, August 28, with new episodes airing weekly until October 30.'}

{'': 'Other notable upcoming Apple TV+ premieres include the Ryan Reynolds film "Mayday," the Matthew McConaughey comedy series "Brothers," and the police thriller "Last Seen."'}

{'': 'Which Apple TV+ premiere are you most excited about? Share with us in the comments.'}

{'': 'Apple TV+ costs $12.99 per month, and can also be subscribed at a discounted rate through the Apple One bundle.'}
